name: Smashing Pumpkins

whyMatters.en: Chicago alternative band; Siamese Dream (1993) and Mellon Collie (1995) stacked wall-of-guitar production into mid-90s alt-radio dominance.
whyMatters.zh: 芝加哥 alternative 乐队；Siamese Dream（1993）与 Mellon Collie（1995）把吉他墙制作堆成 90 年代中期 alt 电台统治。

note.en: Siamese Dream; layered guitars under bright hook.
note.zh: Siamese Dream；明亮钩子下的叠吉他。

note.en: Mellon Collie; drum-loop sheen + nostalgia lyric.
note.zh: Mellon Collie；鼓循环光泽 + 怀旧歌词。

note.en: Distortion chorus rant; Mellon Collie rock face.
note.zh: 失真副歌怒吼；Mellon Collie 摇滚脸。

interviewQuotes.text: I multi-tracked until the guitars were a wall.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Billy Corgan

lyricQuotes: Despite all my rage I am still just a rat in a cage
Shakedown 1979 / Cool kids never have the time

shortBio.en: Corgan wall-of-guitar alt; Siamese Dream / Mellon Collie peak.
shortBio.zh: Corgan 吉他墙 alt；Siamese Dream / Mellon Collie 峰值。

body.en:
Formed 1988. Butch Vig on Siamese Dream stacks endless guitars. Mellon Collie (1995) is double-album ambition + 1979 radio soft cut. Lineup fractures late 90s; Corgan keeps logo.

Production density is the brand beside quieter Pixies dynamics.
body.zh:
1988 年组建。Butch Vig 在 Siamese Dream 上叠无尽吉他。Mellon Collie（1995）是双专野心 + 1979 电台软曲。90 年代末阵容碎裂；Corgan 保住 logo。

制作密度是品牌，对照更安静的 Pixies 动态。

title.zh: 吉他墙 alternative 最大化

body.en:
Corgan multi-tracks guitars into shoegaze-adjacent density without abandoning verse-chorus radio. Siamese Dream is the studio peak; Mellon Collie expands length and soft singles.

Chicago alt that competed with Seattle volume via production, not only grit.
body.zh:
Corgan 把吉他多轨叠到与 shoegaze 相邻的密度，不丢主副歌电台。Siamese Dream 是录音峰值；Mellon Collie 扩展篇幅与软单曲。

用制作而非只靠砂砾与西雅图音量竞争的芝加哥 alt。

body.en:
Corgan / Iha / D'arcy / Chamberlin is the silhouette for Siamese–Mellon. Chamberlin exits/returns; later casts rotate heavily.

Peak flag on mid-90s four.
body.zh:
Corgan / Iha / D'arcy / Chamberlin 是 Siamese–Mellon 剪影。Chamberlin 离队/回归；后来卡司大量轮换。

巅峰旗在 90 年代中四人。

title.en: Corgan control, Iha color, jazz kit
title.zh: Corgan 控制、Iha 色彩、爵士感鼓

body.en:
Corgan: songwriting + most tracked guitars. Iha: complementary lines. D'arcy: bass/image. Chamberlin: fusion-leaning power kit.

Studio hierarchy is Corgan-led; live still four.
body.zh:
Corgan：写作 + 多数叠轨吉他。Iha：互补声部。D'arcy：贝斯/形象。Chamberlin：偏融合的强力鼓。

录音室层级由 Corgan 主导；现场仍是四人。

body.en:
Siamese Dream. Major-key hook over saturated guitars. Irony lyric under candy tone.

Mass entry before Mellon Collie scale.
body.zh:
Siamese Dream。饱和吉他上的大调钩子。糖果音色下的反讽歌词。

Mellon Collie 体量前的大众入口。

body.en:
Drum loop, clean arpeggios, nostalgia. Proves Pumpkins radio range beyond rage singles.

Mellon Collie soft face.
body.zh:
鼓循环、干净分解、怀旧。证明 Pumpkins 电台范围超出怒吼单曲。

Mellon Collie 软脸。

title.zh: 90 年代 alt 制作引用

body.en:
Muse and later arena alt cite Corgan stacking. Sits beside MBV for density, beside Pixies for hooks, beside NIN for 90s ambition scale.

Chicago maximalism on alt radio.
body.zh:
Muse 与后来体育场 alt 引用 Corgan 叠轨。密度旁是 MBV，钩子旁是 Pixies，90 年代野心尺度旁是 NIN。

Alt 电台上的芝加哥最大化。

note.en: Siamese Dream and Mellon Collie peak.
note.zh: Siamese Dream 与 Mellon Collie 巅峰。

note.en: Wall-of-guitar single that fixed Siamese Dream radio ID.
note.zh: 固定 Siamese Dream 电台 ID 的吉他墙单曲。

note.en: Multi-track guitar maximalism as mid-90s alt brand.
note.zh: 多轨吉他最大化作为 90 年代中期 alt 品牌。
